editor.title: Settings of the new interface
editor.loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded: {reason}

scope.label: Settings for
scope.roleHelp: A role profile overrides the common settings for the users of the role. Unticked values come from the common settings.
scope.inherit: Also for subordinate roles without a profile of their own
scope.discard: The changes of this draft are not saved. Discard them?

language.label: Language of the new interface
language.saved: The language is saved for you. The draft is kept.
language.failed: The language could not be saved: {reason}

toolbar.label: Saving
toolbar.resetSectionHelp: Back to the defaults of the module. The mode and the pilot stay. Save to apply.
toolbar.resetSectionRole: Back to the common settings for this role. Save to apply.
toolbar.sectionReset: The section is back to the inherited values. Save to apply.
toolbar.savedNotice: Saved. The changes apply from the next page and in other tabs after a reload.
toolbar.invalid: {n} value is not valid. Nothing was saved. | {n} values are not valid. Nothing was saved.
toolbar.failed: The settings could not be saved: {reason}

conflict.title: Someone saved these settings meanwhile
conflict.unknown: The settings were changed in another window or session.
conflict.loaded: The current settings are loaded; your draft was discarded.

color.format: Enter a colour as #rrggbb, for example #3978fe.
color.tooLight: This colour is too light: it would be hard to see on white.
color.tooDark: This colour is too dark for a light background or panel.

labels.title: Label
labels.help: Leave empty to use the name from the CRM. Up to 60 characters, plain text.
labels.helpRequired: At least one language. Up to 60 characters, plain text.
labels.invalid: Up to {max} characters of plain text, without angle brackets and script addresses.
labels.needOne: Enter the label in at least one language.

icons.title: Icon
icons.none: No icon of its own: the icon of the module

appearance.intro: Colours, density and text size preview on this page at once. Others see them after you save.
appearance.introRole: Tick the values this role gets instead of the common settings.
appearance.localeHelp: For users who keep «As in the CRM» while the CRM language is none of Russian, English or German.
appearance.logoCompany: Logo of the CRM (Settings → Company details)
appearance.logoCustom: Own logo of the new interface
appearance.logoHelp: PNG, JPEG or GIF up to 512 KB. It is stored as PNG, scaled down to 600×200 and shown only in the header of the new interface; documents and the company logo stay as they are.
appearance.titleCompany: No title, as in the CRM ({name})
appearance.titleCustom: Own title next to the logo

menu.intro: The menu of the new interface shows only modules the user may open. Hiding takes an item out of the menu; permissions and direct links stay unchanged.
menu.roleOwn: This role has a menu of its own.
menu.roleCommon: This role uses the common menu.
menu.useOwn: Set up a menu for this role
menu.configured: The menu is set up here.
menu.crmMenu: The menu follows the apps of the CRM. Any change below sets up a menu of its own.
menu.useCrm: Back to the menu of the CRM
menu.crmMenuConfirm: Replace the groups below by the apps of the CRM?
menu.restored: The item is back in the menu.
menu.removeGroupConfirm: Remove the group «{group}»? Its modules appear in the groups of their apps or in «Other modules».
menu.keys: Keyboard: Alt+↑ or Alt+↓ moves the focused item, Enter edits it, Delete hides it.
menu.groupAria: Group «{group}», {count} items. Alt+↑ or Alt+↓ moves the group.
menu.emptyGroup: No items. Drag items here or place modules from the list below.
menu.addRoute: Add a link to a view of the CRM
menu.notPlacedHelp: Modules without a place in the groups above appear by themselves: in the group of their app or in «Other modules». New modules of the CRM come here.
menu.hiddenHelp: Hidden modules stay available by permissions and direct links.
menu.hiddenByCrm: hidden in the menu editor of the CRM
menu.favoritesHelp: Users choose their favorites in their preferences.
menu.previewRole: Shown with your permissions. Users of the role do not see items without permissions.
menu.previewHelp: Shown with your permissions; each user sees only what they may open.
menu.unknownModules: Not in this CRM and skipped: {modules}.

route.viewHelp: Name of a view of the module, for example List.
route.filterHelp: Filters are numbered per CRM: after moving the settings to another CRM, check it.

access.commonOnly: Users and roles belong to the common settings. Choose «Everyone» to edit them.

modeHelp.off: everybody works with the standard view.
modeHelp.pilot: only the users and roles listed below get the new interface.
modeHelp.all: all users get the new interface.

access.pilotHelp: Membership only chooses the interface; it gives no access to data.
access.rolesHelp: A profile changes appearance, menu and excluded screens for a role. Roles of the CRM and their permissions are not changed.
access.removeProfileConfirm: Remove the profile of the role «{role}»? Its users get the common settings again.
access.profileOwnInherit: own profile, also for subordinate roles
access.personalHelp: {n} user has personal settings. | {n} users have personal settings.
access.personalReset: The personal settings of {user} are reset.

compatibility.intro: Screens listed here always open in the standard view, for example a screen of an extension that does not work well with the new interface.
compatibility.invalid: Use names of letters, digits and _, or * for any value; the module is required.
compatibility.example: Example: module Reports, view *, area empty — all report screens.
compatibility.safeMode: Safe mode shows the CRM in the standard view until you sign out:
compatibility.classic: This settings page also works without the editor:
compatibility.adaptersIntro: An adapter fits the new interface to the screens of one public extension. It only works while the extension is installed and enabled and its version has been checked; the files of the extension are never changed. Switch an adapter off if the screens of the extension look worse after an update of the extension — the common styling stays.
compatibility.adapterOnlyGlobal: Adapters are switched on and off in the common settings.

status.version: Version of the extension not checked
status.incomplete: Files or tables of the extension are missing

transfer.exportHelp: A JSON file to move the settings to another CRM. Users are named by their login, roles by their path, modules by their name; no record of the CRM, no secret and no logo is included.
transfer.usersNote: Personal settings contain the logins of the users and only the keys users may change.
transfer.importHelp: Choose a file of up to 256 KB. Nothing changes before you look at the report and apply it.
transfer.dirty: Save or cancel the changes of the editor before applying an import.
transfer.unresolvedUsers: Not found in this CRM, skipped: {names}.
transfer.unresolvedRoles: Roles not found in this CRM, skipped: {names}.
transfer.ambiguousRoles: Several roles have this path, skipped: {names}.
transfer.includeMode: Also apply the mode of the new interface: {before} → {after}
transfer.usersChanged: {n} of them gets changes. | {n} of them get changes.
transfer.uploadLogo: The file comes with a logo of its own that is not transferred: upload it in «Appearance».
transfer.unknownModules: Modules that this CRM does not have are kept and skipped in the menu: {modules}.
transfer.checkFilters: Links with a filter number: check the filters after the import.
transfer.invalid: {n} value is not valid and is skipped: | {n} values are not valid and are skipped:
transfer.applyConfirm: Apply the chosen parts of the file? The settings of these parts are replaced.
transfer.stale: The settings changed after the check. Choose the file again to see the current report.

fields.theme_allowSelfEnable: Users may try the new interface themselves during a pilot
fields.theme_allowOptOut: Users may switch to the standard view
fields.locale_default: Default language of the new interface
fields.navigation_favoritesEnabled: Show favorites at the top of the menu

prefs.title: My preferences of the new interface
prefs.active: The new interface is on for you.
prefs.inactive: The new interface is off for you; your preferences apply once it is on.
prefs.nothing: The administrator allows no personal changes.
prefs.languageHelp: Changes the texts of ModernUI only, at once and without losing what you entered. Names of modules and fields stay in the language of your CRM profile; your CRM language and formats are not changed.
prefs.favoritesHelp: Up to 30 modules at the top of the menu; chosen: {count}. Alt+↑ or Alt+↓ moves the focused one.
prefs.standardViewHelp: The CRM looks as before ModernUI; you can come back here at any time.
prefs.saved: Saved. The changes apply from the next page.
prefs.resetConfirm: Reset all your preferences of the new interface?
